cardOverview.overviewText: An entry-level Axis Bank card offering rewards on online shopping, recharges, and dining, with simple features crafted for first-time cardholders.

items.child: 10% off on Booking Movie Tickets on BookMyShow

benefitRows.name: 10% off on Blinkit
benefitRows.offer: 10% off up to Rs. 250 on minimum transaction value of Rs. 750, valid once per card per month on Blinkit
benefitRows.howToAvail: Log on to www.blinkit.com or Blinkit mobile app.|Add products to your shopping carts.|Enter the promo code ‘AXISNEO’ under "Promo Code & Bank Offers" at the time of checkout.|Make the payment in full using an eligible Axis Bank Neo Credit Card.

benefitRows.name: BookMyShow
benefitRows.description: 10% off on Booking Movie Tickets on BookMyShow
benefitRows.offer: Eligible Axis Bank Neo Credit cardholders will get a 10% discount per transaction on the tickets purchased through www.bookmyshow.com or on the BookMyShow mobile app.|Each customer can get a maximum discount of Rs.100 per month.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this offer, visit the BookMyShow website or app.|Select your movie, date, time, and seats.|Proceed to payment and find the offers/discounts section.|Select the applicable bank discount offer and enter your card details.|Complete the payment to get the Offer.
